description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by graph-0022. The SKOS integrity rule: broader on a cluster file is nesting, exported as parent skos:member child. skos:broader has domain and range skos:Concept and skos:Collection is disjoint with skos:Concept, so emitting skos:broader on a Cluster would entail a contradiction and fail every SKOS validator.
reason: AGSC-04-15 was amended at rc.6 (PY2-01) to pin the graph term of every line of graph.nq as the Bundle IRI; this case states its lines as triples in the default graph, which that rule now excludes. The corrected case ships as graph-0022 (AGSC-00-16: a released vector is never edited in place).
